product_family: Craft is a privacy-first productivity app (notes, tasks, docs, calendar, whiteboards) with integrated AI assistant (GPT-4o, LLaMa, DeepSeek) and extensive integrations (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Raycast, Apple Shortcuts, Lovable, Replit). Multi-platform: iOS, iPad, Mac, Windows, Vision Pro, Android, and web.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Craft achieved SOC 2 Type 2 compliance on April 18, 2023. An independent auditor has rigorously assessed our security controls and confirmed that they meet the criteria set by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA). Craft commits to maintaining the certification on an ongoing basis, with annual renewal planned.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on vendor-domain pages. Craft mentions they are happy to provide compliance documentation upon request, but ISO 27001 is not claimed on their security or help pages.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Craft's privacy policy helps the company comply with data privacy laws, such as the GDPR. Craft does not sell user data to third parties, does not use it for advertising, and has undergone third-party audits to validate commitments. Users can request deletion of personal information.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification or compliance claims on vendor-domain pages. Craft is not marketed as HIPAA-compliant.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification on vendor-domain pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: Craft explicitly states: 'Craft does not use your content to train AI models.' When using AI features, only the minimum data required to process a single request is sent to AI providers (OpenAI, LLaMa, DeepSeek). Token usage and costs are recorded, but not user text or request content. Chat history stays on user device with local-first, privacy-first architecture. API requests from external providers are not retained for model training.
privacy.data_region: AWS (primary cloud hosting). Company registered in London, UK; operations also in Budapest, Hungary.

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: Ongoing system monitoring for security vulnerabilities; regular third-party penetration testing

security.name: Employee training
security.value: Regular security awareness training for employees

security.name: Security reviews
security.value: Security review process for all system changes; reviews at multiple stages of SDLC

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: Commitment to notify users within 72 hours of learning about a data breach

security.name: Third-party audits
security.value: Completed third-party audits to validate data protection commitments; willing to provide additional compliance documentation upon request

security.name: Authentication
security.value: Multiple secure login methods: email verification codes, Apple ID, Google authentication

security.name: Data ownership philosophy
security.value: User data is treated as user property; not sold to third parties or used for advertising

products.name: Craft (Core product)
products.data_scope: Notes, tasks, documents, calendar events, whiteboard content, user-generated data
products.notes: Available on iOS, iPad, Mac, Windows, Vision Pro, Android, web. Freemium model (free tier + Plus at €4.80-8.00/month). Data encrypted at rest and in transit. Syncs across devices with local-first architecture.

products.name: Craft AI Assistant
products.data_scope: User prompts and content passed to AI models (OpenAI, LLaMa, DeepSeek) for processing only
products.notes: Does NOT train on customer data. Supports on-device models (LLaMa, DeepSeek) for offline/privacy-first use, and cloud models (GPT-4o) for advanced capabilities. Chat history stored locally on device. Only minimum data sent per request.

products.name: Craft MCP
products.data_scope: MCP connections to other tools (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Raycast, other MCP clients)
products.notes: Extensibility layer. Users control third-party integration access; can disconnect integrations anytime to stop data sharing.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Free tier with full core functionality; Plus tier at €4.80-8.00/month (annual discount available). Education plan available.
compare.data_residency: AWS-hosted (cloud); data stored in AWS with encryption at rest (SSE-S3) and in transit (TLS). Company registered UK, operations in UK and Hungary.
